name: 2026 Primary - Special Democratic Primary Member of the City Council District 3

rcvRoundsInfo.description: Round 1: First-choice preferences across all 5 candidates (Wilson 42.5%, Murphy 32.2%, Lieberman 14.5%, Ward 8.8%, Write-ins 2.0%).
Round 2: Write-ins and Wacoma Ward eliminated; votes transferred to secondary preferences.
Round 3: Robyn Lieberman eliminated; Carl Wilson crosses 50% majority threshold with 58.3% to win!
